name: Property Owners Task Force Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda

ILLS

  Please be advised that pre-en try metal detector screening requirements are now in place

  In the interest of maintaining appropriate social distancing, members of the public can view this
  meeting through live webcast at www.beverlyhills.org/llve and on BH Channel 10 or Channel 35
  on Spectrum Cable, and can participate in the teleconference/video conference by using the link
  above. Written comments may be emailed to mayorandcitycoundil(ãbeverlyhils.or.g and will also
  be taken during the meeting when the topic is being reviewed by the Beverly Hills City Council
  Liaison/Property Owners Task Force Committee. Beverly Hills Liaison meetings will be in-person
  at City Hall.

  AGENDA

  1) Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on any item listed on the agenda.

  2) Welcome and Introductions

  3) City Council Parking Facades Meeting Update
   4) Presentation on the LA Metro North Portal

  5) Update from Community Development Department Permit Center

  6) Information Sharing & Discussion
  a. Current commercial retail leasing activity
  b. Tenants coming-in; tenants leaving
  c. Available spaces (current and future spaces)

  7) Future Agenda Items Discussion

  8) Adjournment

Huma Ahmed
City Clerk

Posted: June 16, 2023
